name: ab-rest-w
js: (async()=>{const r=K.allDishes.find(x=>x.type==="fish");location.hash="#/r/"+r.r;await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,1500));K.openDish(r.r,r.id);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1300));const s=document.querySelector(".ds-scroll");const a=document.querySelector(".ds-about");a&&a.scrollIntoView({block:"start"});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));return [r.r, !!document.querySelector(".ds-hist"), [...document.querySelectorAll(".ds-cmp h3")].map(h=>h.textContent), [...document.querySelectorAll(".da-r dt")].map(x=>x.textContent)]})()
